ideas.pitch: An AI-powered terminal and cloud incident management assistant controlled entirely through natural voice commands.
ideas.title: VocalOps: Voice-Controlled DevOps Incident Responder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Voice AI Track sponsored by ElevenLabs by integrating low-latency voice synthesis and recognition with real cloud infrastructure actions.

ideas.pitch: A secure code review agent that uses zero-knowledge proofs to verify code compliance with proprietary security policies without exposing raw source code to third-party LLMs.
ideas.title: SecureStream: ZK-Gated AI Code Review Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced cryptography with practical developer tooling, appealing strongly to OWASP security judges and matching winning patterns in agentic systems.

ideas.pitch: A tool that parses incoming multi-language codebases in real-time and renders interactive 3D topology and dependency graphs for developer teams.
ideas.title: CodeSync: Collaborative Real-Time Architecture Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on delivering a visually striking and technically complex live demo that solves actual pain points in onboarding engineers to legacy codebases.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight static and dynamic analysis wrapper that scans configuration files and smart contracts for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, generating an automated remediation script.
ideas.title: AuditAI: Automated Smart Contract and Config Security Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the OWASP sponsor track by addressing real-world software security vulnerabilities with an actionable, highly practical developer utility.

ideas.pitch: A documentation generator that listens to developer voice notes during a sprint planning session and automatically updates markdown docs and API schemas.
ideas.title: VoiceDocs: Conversational Code Documentation Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages ElevenLabs voice capabilities to solve a tedious developer chore, making it a crowd-pleasing submission for the Voice AI bounty track.
